description: The study advocates measuring emotions repeatedly after every session and analysing them with dynamic structural equation modelling, a process-oriented, intra-individual approach \"only recently applied in educational research\".
title: Dynamic structural equation modelling for intra-individual emotion trajectories

description: The article proposes dynamical systems theory and associated analysis techniques as tools for examining behavioral patterns and variations within ITSs.
title: Dynamical-systems analysis of intelligent tutoring system process data

description: The article proposes dissecting the genetic liability for dyslexia into components based on their relationship with educational attainment, using EA as a proxy for school performance that reflects both cognitive abilities and noncognitive influences.
title: Dyslexia–educational attainment polygenic-liability partitioning method
